meta.title: Sidebar downloads
meta.description: Download workspace files; package directories and multiple selections as ZIP.

ui.title: Select files to download
ui.invalid-selection: The selection contains an unsupported path.
ui.listing-truncated: This directory exceeds the server listing limit. Choose a smaller directory.
ui.unsupported-entry: The selection contains a link, alias, or unsupported entry.
ui.not-found: The session or selected file no longer exists.
ui.size-limit: The selection exceeds the download size limit. Select fewer files.
ui.entry-limit: The selection contains too many entries. Select fewer files.
ui.read-failed: Cannot prepare the download. Check access and file-size limits, then retry.
ui.incomplete-read: The file could not be read completely. Retry the download.
ui.file-changed: A file changed while being read. Prepare the download again.
ui.expired: The prepared download expired or was already used. Prepare it again.
ui.busy: The server is preparing other downloads. Try again shortly.
ui.denied: Downloading requires the owner's authenticated browser session.
